## How to work

- Identify yourself on every command: `--as <you>`, or set `LANES_AGENT=<you>`, or `git config user.name <you>` in your worktree.
- Read state through the CLI only: `npx lanes board`, `npx lanes questions open`. Never load `agents/board.jsonl` or `agents/questions.jsonl` raw.
- Start: `npx lanes claim <task> --as <you>`. Shared resources: `npx lanes lock <resource> --as <you> --ttl 2h`, then `npx lanes unlock <resource> --as <you>`.
- Need the owner: `npx lanes ask --as <you> --text "..." --blocking <task> --default "..." --expires 2d`. Keep working on the default if it is safe.
- Finish: write `agents/reports/<task>-<you>.md` with frontmatter `task, agent, flags, tests_run, native_boot, files_changed`, then `npx lanes status <task> REVIEW --as <you>`.
- Owner decisions live only in `agents/DECISIONS.md` (D-001, D-002, …). Cite the number; never restate a decision elsewhere.
- Specs: `agents/inbox/<agent>/`. Shared interface contracts: `agents/specs/` (change them there first).
- The pre-commit hook (`lanes check`) refuses commits outside your lane.
- Three failed attempts at the same step: stop, write the report, set the task BLOCKED.
